Definition: to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to crush, oppress; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to crush, get crushed, be crushed; 1a2) to crush, oppress (fig); 1a3) crushed (participle passive); 1b) (Niphal) to be crushed, be broken; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to crush in pieces; 1c2) to grievously oppress (fig); 1d) (Poel) to oppress (fig); 1e) (Hiphil) to crush; 1f) (Hithpoel) to crush each other
